subject: Tenant initialization & security ops sprint for Redwood integration
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah@zenithpayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant initialization & security ops sprint for Redwood integration

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet yesterday. To make the integration run smoothly we typically do a short Security Ops sprint that covers four focused items:

1) SSO (SAML) metadata exchange and verification
2) SCIM attribute mapping & a service-account-based sync for provisioning
3) IP allowlist / egress policy review for backend callbacks
4) Organization-level policies (role mappings, admin delegation, service account lifecycle)

Attached is our tenant security checklist and a starter SAML metadata blob and SCIM mapping template. Proposed timeline: prep by 2027-09-22, sprint window 2027-09-27 to 2027-09-29, verification & post-checks 2027-10-01.

Can you confirm who from your side will own the SAML metadata exchange and who will provision SCIM sample users for the test sync? Also, please confirm any static IPs we should expect so we can prepare the allowlist template.

Action items for Redwood: we (Jonas) will own the SCIM mapping review; Neha will coordinate the org-policies checklist and run the pre-flight verification.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

— Ben
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_tenant_security_checklist.pdf, saml-metadata.xml, scim-attribute-mapping.csv, ip-allowlist-template.csv

From: Sarah Klein <sarah@zenithpayments.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Ops <it-ops@zenithpayments.com>, Compliance Team <compliance@zenithpayments.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant initialization & security ops sprint for Redwood integration

Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan. My team will own SAML metadata exchange (I will get you a signed metadata file by 9/20). IT Ops will stand up sample SCIM accounts — I cc'ed them here so they have context.

Two quick notes from Compliance:
- They want confirmation that SCIM syncs run under a dedicated, non-interactive service account with scoped permissions (read/write limited to user attributes only).
- They need expected retention for audit logs (we can share your standard retention policy).

We will provide source IPs for allowlisting by EOD 9/22. Happy to join a 30-min alignment call next week if you want to walk through the mapping.

— Sarah Klein
Director, IT Integrations
Zenith Payments

On Thu, Sep 14, 2027 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Tenant initialization & security ops sprint for Redwood integration

Thanks — couple of internal notes / proposals:

- SCIM service account: naming convention redwood-scim-<tenant>-<env> and we will apply least privilege (Users: read/write, Groups: read-only unless requested).
- SAML: we will send a validation checklist to Sarah's team (certificate fingerprint, ACS URL, entityID).
- IP allowlist: ask Zenith if they need bi-directional allowlisting (our callbacks originate from a small set of egress IPs, we will provide those).
- Org policies: we should present a short mapping doc for Admin roles vs Zenith IAM roles; Neha can draft a starter mapping and include delegation guidance.

I can lead the SCIM mapping session during the sprint. Neha will prepare the policy mapping doc and the runbook for post-cutover.

- Action: Ben to schedule the alignment call and share the Drive link.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Tenant initialization & security ops sprint for Redwood integration

Sarah / IT Ops —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Looping in specifics so we have a shared checklist before the sprint:

Pre-sprint deliverables (by 2027-09-22):
- Zenith: SAML metadata file (signed), list of source IPs for allowlisting, and 5 test SCIM user records (name, email, role).
- Redwood: SCIM mapping draft (Jonas), SAML validation checklist (Jonas), org-policy starter doc (Neha), and a temporary allowlist CSV for your team to confirm.

Sprint schedule (tentative):
- 2027-09-27 10:00-12:00 — SAML validation & test sign-on (Jonas + IT Ops)
- 2027-09-27 14:00-16:00 — SCIM mapping session + test sync (Jonas + IT Ops)
- 2027-09-28 11:00-12:00 — IP allowlist verification & callback end-to-end tests (Neha + IT Ops)
- 2027-09-29 09:00-10:00 — Post-cutover checklist, runbook handoff, and audit log confirmation (Neha + Compliance)

I've created a pinned Drive folder and added initial artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/s/tenant-security-runbook (permissions set to Zenith and Redwood core team). Please confirm the times above or propose alternatives.

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (Redwood sample), scim-attribute-mapping.csv (Jonas draft)

— Ben

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sarah Klein <sarah@zenithpayments.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant initialization & security ops sprint for Redwood integration

All —

Quick confirmation: Zenith's IT Ops sent the SCIM sample users and the SAML metadata this morning. I've added them to the Drive folder and updated the org-policy starter doc with Zenith role mappings (see link). I've also scheduled the sprint meetings and sent calendar invites for the times Ben proposed (with a 30-min alignment call on 2027-09-23 for final pre-flight review).

Two compliance notes we actioned:
- Service account created with scoped permissions and a rotation reminder set for 90 days.
- Audit retention: Redwood will retain auth/audit records for 12 months by default; for Zenith we can extend to 24 months under an enterprise agreement if needed.

Next steps: Jonas will run the SCIM mapping session on 9/27; Ben will lead the SAML sign-on test on the morning of 9/27. I'll coordinate post-sprint verification and close the checklist.

Thanks — Neha
Principal Product Manager, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
